training_contract.target_limit: screened original recording is a clean-reference proxy, not pristine GT
training_contract.source_verification: original source SHA was verified at materialization; this run re-verifies NPZ content/provenance
training_contract.guide_geometry: SR: float Torch bicubic antialias to HR; native tasks: unchanged RGB
training_contract.anchor: Q4(rgb), canonical Torch bicubic antialias, NOT the physical observation operator
training_contract.observation_encoder_scope: blind variants only; known always uses public-condition MLP

optimizer.confidence: same settings in a separate optimizer when head is present

lr_schedule.name: linear_warmup_then_cosine_floor
lr_schedule.application: base_lr * warmup * decay; same schedule for both optimizers

determinism.seed_policy: Python/NumPy/Torch seeded before CPU model initialization; NPU seeded when used

training_contract.sampling: step-addressed PCG64, balanced task slots; identical for every arm
training_contract.near_clean: data module fixed low Gaussian sigma recipe; source frames stay in original split

loss.confidence: detached error Gaussian NLL; separate optimizer; no fidelity reweighting

training_contract.evaluation: final checkpoint, all dev tasks, original RGB; training crop validation is diagnostic only
training_contract.rphi_scope: standalone canonical RGB prototype; no H3 integration, soft DC or recurrent state yet

metric_contract.rgb: float32 clipped [0,1], no prediction quantization; original recording RGB proxy
metric_contract.baseline: SR: torch bicubic antialias=True align_corners=False; native tasks: observed RGB identity
metric_contract.psnr: mean per-frame RGB PSNR, unit peak; exact-zero MSE capped at 120 dB
metric_contract.aggregation: windows averaged within source, then equal source weights; controls excluded from task scores
metric_contract.temporal: selected frame pairs t,t+frame_stride; full RGB error-change, no x4 band/physical-null claim
metric_contract.calibration: raw unclamped RGB errors, separate from quality metrics; nominal Gaussian coverage is a diagnostic
metric_contract.causal_context: original consecutive frames t-2..t with first-frame repetition
metric_contract.control_inputs: explicit identity and sigma=1/255 near-clean RGB controls from target; never ordinary dev input
metric_contract.comparison_limit: development ablations, not an untouched generalization test

dataset_provenance.target_semantics: shared clean original-recording RGB reference proxy
dataset_provenance.control_condition: retain nominal task/scale; control label is not a model condition

sr_input_preparation.role: HR input guide; not the physical forward operator

per_sample.flow: GT-proxy Farneback forward flow; in-bounds + forward/backward consistency mask

chunk_equivalence.context: absolute original frame t-2..t; history preserved across groups
